title: Q3Edit – Edit and play Quake 3 maps in the browser
claim: Show HN: Q3Edit – Edit and play Quake 3 maps in the browser
why_good: Edit and play Quake 3 maps in the browser — a nostalgic, technically impressive toy for a passionate retro-gaming niche.
value: Hobbyist/nostalgia project; hard to monetize beyond community/donations.
risk: Fan project on old IP (id/Quake); legal grey area and a tiny market — a labor of love, not a company.
